content: PEP 723 inline dependencies (# /// script / # dependencies = [...] / # ///) invoked via 'uv run scripts/myscript.py' — uv auto-installs deps, caches, no venv needed. Alternative: plain pip install in script preamble when uv not guaranteed. For fdars[mcp]: if not on PyPI as extra, must do 'pip install fdars mcp' separately or 'pip install git+https://github.com/sipemu/pyfda[mcp]'. Scripts must be non-interactive, output JSON/structured data to stdout, diagnostics to stderr.
